lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, all the sins are erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਫਾਸਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur simarat jam sa(n)g na phaasahi ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, one is not strangled by the noose of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur simarat man niramal hovai gur kaate apamaanaa he ||2||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, the mind becomes immaculate; the Guru eliminates egotistical pride. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sevak narak na jaae ||
lines.translation: The Guru's servant is not consigned to hell.
The Guru's servant meditates on the Supreme Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sevak saadhasa(n)g paae gur karadaa nit jee daanaa he ||3||
lines.translation: The Guru's servant joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the Guru ever gives the life of the soul. ||3||
At the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bhet har jas mukh bhaneeai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, one chants the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kal kales mitaae satigur har daragah devai maanaa(n) he ||4||
lines.translation: The True Guru eradicates sorrow and suffering, and bestows honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||
The Guru has revealed the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.
The True Guru returns to the Path, those who have wandered away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevak kau bighan na bhagatee har poor driRhaaiaa giaanaa(n) he ||5||
lines.translation: No obstacles stand in the way of devotion to the Lord, for one who serves the Guru. The Guru implants perfect spiritual wisdom. ||5||
The Guru has revealed the Lord everywhere.
The Lord of the Universe is permeating and pervading the water and the land.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਊਨ ਸਭ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ooch oon sabh ek samaanaa(n) man laagaa sahaj dhiaanaa he ||6||
lines.translation: The high and the low are all the same to Him. Focus your mind's meditation intuitively on Him. ||6||
Meeting with the Guru, all thirst is quenched.
Meeting with the Guru, one is not watched by Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਪਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh deeaa gur poorai naam a(n)mrit pee paanaa(n) he ||7||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru bestows truth and contentment; I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee baanee sabh maahi samaanee ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Bani is contained in all.
He Himself hears it, and He Himself repeats it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਸਤ੍ਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jin jin japee teee sabh nisatre tin paaiaa nihachal thaanaa(n) he ||8||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on it, are all emancipated; they attain the eternal and unchanging home. ||8||
The Glory of the True Guru is known only to the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kare s aapan bhaanai ||
lines.translation: Whatever He does, is according to the Pleasure of His Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੯॥੧॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo dhoor jaachahi jan tere naanak sad kurabaanaa(n) he ||9||1||4||
lines.translation: Your humble servants beg for the dust of the feet of the Holy; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||9||1||4||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Primal, Immaculate Lord God is formless.
The Detached Lord is Himself prevailing in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: varan jaat chihan nahee koee sabh hukame srisat upaaidaa ||1||
lines.translation: He has no race or social class, no identifying mark. By the Hukam of His Will, He created the entire universe. ||1||
Out of all the 8.4 million species of beings,
God blessed mankind with glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: is pauRee te jo nar chookai so aai jaai dukh paaidaa ||2||
lines.translation: That human who misses this chance, shall suffer the pains of coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
What should I say, to one who has been created.
The Gurmukh receives the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭੂਲੈ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jis aap bhulaae soee bhoolai so boojhai jisahi bujhaaidaa ||3||
lines.translation: He alone is confused, whom the Lord Himself confuses. He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਨਗਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog kaa nagar ihu keeaa ||
lines.translation: This body has been made the village of joy and sorrow.
They alone are emancipated, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: trihaa gunaa te rahai niraaraa so guramukh sobhaa paaidaa ||4||
lines.translation: One who remains untouched by the three qualities, the three gunas - such a Gurmukh is blessed with glory. ||4||
You can do anything, but whatever you do,
Only serves to tie your feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਰੁਤਾ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kurutaa beej beeje nahee ja(n)mai sabh laahaa mool gavaaidaa ||5||
lines.translation: The seed which is planted out of season does not sprout, and all one's capital and profits are lost. ||5||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are most sublime and exalted.
Become Gurmukh, chant and focus your meditation.
